<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# First reverse the middle frame shift (click green), then probe top frame
# Green button for middle frame is at (25,47)-(28,49), center ~ (26,48)

action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 26, 'col': 48}])

# Verify reversal
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
row26_colors = []
for n in seg:
    if n['pixels'] == 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if r == 26:
            row26_colors.append((c, n['color']))
row26_colors.sort()
print(f"Row 26 after green: {row26_colors}")

# Original was: w(17), b(20), b(23), w(26), S(29), p(32), g(35), S(38), g(41), g(44)
original_row26 = [(17,'w'), (20,'b'), (23,'b'), (26,'w'), (29,'S'), (32,'p'), (35,'g'), (38,'S'), (41,'g'), (44,'g')]
print(f"Original row 26: {original_row26}")
print(f"Match: {row26_colors == original_row26}")

# Now probe top frame red button at (16,19)-(19,21), center ~ (17,20)
def get_all_tile_colors(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation['nodes']
    tiles = {}
    for n in seg:
        if n['pixels'] == 4:
            b = n['boundary']
            r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if r > 10:
                tiles[(r,c)] = n['color']
    return tiles

before_top = get_all_tile_colors(current_frame)
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 17, 'col': 20}])
after_top = get_all_tile_colors(current_frame)

changed_top = []
for pos in sorted(set(list(before_top.keys()) + list(after_top.keys()))):
    bc = before_top.get(pos, '?')
    ac = after_top.get(pos, '?')
    if bc != ac:
        changed_top.append((pos, bc, ac))

print(f"\nTop frame red click changed ({len(changed_top)}):")
for pos, bc, ac in changed_top:
    print(f"  {pos}: {bc} → {ac}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

# Now probe top frame red button at (16,19)-(19,21), center ~ (17,20)
def get_all_tile_colors(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation['nodes']
    tiles = {}
    for n in seg:
        if n['pixels'] == 4:
            b = n['boundary']
            r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if r > 10:
                tiles[(r,c)] = n['color']
    return tiles

    bc = before_top.get(pos, '?')
    ac = after_top.get(pos, '?')
    if bc != ac:
